versions.changelog:
- Added a summary field for improved discoverability.
- Updated the binary path in config instructions for clarity (now suggests ./shodh-memory-server or adding to PATH).

- Initial release of shodh-local: local Shodh-Memory v0.1.74 for persistent, offline cognitive memory.
- Supports remembering, semantic recall, GTD-style todos, projects, and knowledge graph operations.
- Offers RESTful API endpoints for memory, recall (semantic and by tag), proactive context, todos, and projects.
- Features 3-tier Hebbian learning memory (working/session/LTM), a TUI dashboard, and best practices for agent use.
- Quick setup and API usage instructions included for local/offline deployment.
